item.title: Release Notes
item.description: 0.30.0 (2026-10-27) Allow concurrent benchmark runs Support clustered benchmarks via CLI Calculate throughput using request fired time instead of scheduled time Record blocked time in the bucket of the request it blocked Optimize SSH file transfer by batching uploads Make agent initialization timeout configurable Report a crashed agent as FAILED instead of STOPPING Fix parsing scheduleDelay min/max as nanoseconds Fix coordinate omission on HotRodRequestStep and StopwatchBeginStep Fix K8sDeployer client construction under Vert.
